entries.title: Updates from GitHub
notes: Looks for new versions on the public releases page on GitHub first, and checks every download's size and fingerprint before installing it.
If GitHub cannot be reached it still updates from the Dell, as before.
The update message says where the new version came from.
An older download never replaces a newer install unless you run it with -force.

entries.title: Tidies up after older versions
notes: Removes what older versions left behind: old copies in your bin folder, the downloaded installer, old data folders and old start-up entries.
Shortcuts that pointed at an old copy now open the installed one.
Tells Claude Control it is installed, so the board menu shows its version.

entries.title: Installs like a normal Windows app
notes: Moves itself to your Programs folder and appears in Settings › Apps › Installed apps, with an Uninstall button.
Adds a Start menu entry under One Development.
New Tools › Start with Windows; it replaces the old logon task, which had stopped working.

entries.title: New look
notes: New colours and styling, with an overview strip and a two-minute traffic chart.
Animations show real traffic and health checks on each tunnel.

entries.title: First update through the updater
notes: A small release to prove the built-in updater works from start to finish.

entries.title: Built-in updater
notes: Checks for new versions and installs one when you click Update, then restarts itself into it.
If a new version will not start it goes back to the previous one by itself; Help › Roll back does it by hand.

entries.title: Tidier tunnel tables
notes: The tunnel tables' columns now line up.
Shorter About text.

entries.title: Renamed to Tunnel Control
notes: Rojo Tunnel Monitor is now Tunnel Control. Your tunnels and settings came across.

entries.title: Avatar Showroom tunnel
notes: Adds the Avatar Showroom stage's port to the starting tunnel list.

entries.title: Stage ports
notes: Adds the lab's stage ports to the starting tunnel list.

entries.title: Menus and Options
notes: Proper Windows menus and an Options dialog.
Choose what closing and minimising do (hide to the tray or not).

entries.title: Groups and connection tests
notes: Tunnels in groups, traffic counters, a Test connection button and the tray icon.
